title: Kestra Failures by Flow
app: Kestra execution events via the Kestra API to HEC and server logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=kestra:execution state="FAILED"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by flow_id
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Kestra failures grouped by flow so operators immediately see which specific flows are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Kestra is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Kestra failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical flows.
visualization: Table of flow by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Kestra are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
